hierarchy-bundles.visual_critic_note: Clean card layout and deliberate edge color (#476376) show some design thought, but Tableau10 colors remain recognizable as default D3, the 900×900 SVG overflows its card container in the screenshot, and the debug controls (FPS counter, easing params) fragment the presentation into a developer sketch rather than a polished demo.
hierarchy-bundles.encoding_integrity_note: Correct scaleSqrt for node size and sunburst radial encoding, data-driven domains via d3.extent, key functions on all data joins, ordinal color scale — no quantitative deception risks; line.defined() omitted but inapplicable to bundled topology paths.
hierarchy-bundles.stress_test_note: Tension slider fires a full redraw of all ~300 link paths on every input event with no RAF coalescing or debounce; force layout starts its simulation while a concurrent 750ms shape-morph transition is still in-flight with no prior .interrupt() call; drag and hover handlers carry no touch/mouse source filtering.
hierarchy-bundles.cognitive_load_note: 300 bundled edges across 200 nodes in circle-pack form creates a dense hairball at low tension — bundles lack natural convergence paths in this layout, the 8-mode control surface adds overhead, and animation/morph quality (Flubber + 200-node position interpolation) cannot be assessed from a static screenshot.
